name: Siren — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Siren from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Mythic Siren", "Siren (Mythic)" but are not part of the Siren entry, which is unchanged.

DR 5/epic Immune mind-affecting effects

Melee 2 talons +11 (1d6)
Special Attacks bardic performance, love at first sightM, mythic power (3/day, surge +1d6), siren’s song, sneak attack +2d6

3/day—cause fear (DC 17), charm person (DC 17), deep slumber (DC 19), shout (DC 20)
